text: So Good Together is the twenty-fourth studio album by American country music singer Reba McEntire, released in 1999. It was preceded by the single "What Do You Say," which reached number 3 on the country singles chart and was nominated for a Grammy in the category of Best Short Form Video. The song also achieved her highest-charting position on the Billboard Hot 100, peaking at number 31. The album was certified platinum by the RIAA. It peaked at number 5 on the Billboard Top Country Albums chart and number 28 on the Billboard 200, with sales of 49,000 copies. The North American version and International version of the album are noted in the liner notes. Tracks 1, 4, 8, and 10 are included in the North American version; tracks 2, 3, 5, and 11 are in the International version; track 12 is listed separately; and tracks 6, 7, and 9 are part of the International version. Shipments figures are based on certification alone.
